title: Atlas
tagline: Autonomous AI trading protocol with EVM escrow caps, Backpack L2 & Hedera audit logs.
description:

Currently, most autonomous AI crypto trading bots have two drawbacks: they are either perilous black boxes or they require the use of TypeScript or Solidity programming languages to modify a trading rule. Atlas was created to address this trust and accessibility concern in trading.

Atlas enables traders to easily create automated trading logic like Dip Buying, Momentum breakout, and customized price triggers at a visual no-code level. One of their most remarkable features is that every trading event is conducted through smart, agent vault non-custodial contracts (AgentVault.sol). Users impose a number of restrictions on their spending, going from dictating the upper limit on each trade to establishing the maximum amount of money to spend throughout the trading process and involving traders in multiple steps of trading activity.

When using the service, users are able to see the execution of the trading strategy on the shocking depth interest order book from Backpack Exchange and TradingView candlestick charts simultaneously. Moreover, every trading signal and emergency kill switch are being recorded immutably on Hedera Consensus Service (HCS) along with links to HashScan, thus guaranteeing the complete audit trail.
how_its_made: Atlas is built as an autonomous quantitative crypto trading protocol pairing low-latency Backpack Exchange L2 orderbook depth with non-custodial EVM escrow smart contracts (AgentVault.sol). Built using Next.js 14, Foundry, and TypeScript, the platform programmatically enforces lifetime spending caps, per-trade ceilings, and human approval gates on-chain. Every AI trade signal and kill-switch activation is logged immutably onto Hedera Consensus Service (Topic #0.0.48912) for a 100% cryptographic audit trail. Oversized trades pause safely in an EVM pending queue for human owner signature
auto_summary: Atlas combines a no-code trading rules interface, an on-chain escrow vault, and off-chain services for executing and auditing automated trades.
